user_problem: A serialization contract needs examples that expose normalization, omission, and information-loss boundaries offline.
unique_output: A casebook pairing source values, serialized forms, reconstructed values, expected equality, and ambiguity notes.
required_input: Type rules, serialization format, omission defaults, normalization rules, and representative synthetic values.
critical_rule: Use only documented transformations and distinguish semantic equality from byte-for-byte equality.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is cli-help-example-designer; this creates data roundtrip cases rather than command-line usage examples.
acceptance_scenario: Input says missing nickname is omitted, empty nickname is preserved, and dates normalize to UTC. Output includes separate missing and empty cases plus 2026-01-01T02:00+02:00 reconstructing as 2026-01-01T00:00Z semantically equal.
